    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-06-role-map-and-staffing-triggers</b><br>

  <div class="ws-instruction">

      <p class="ws-sub">Name each emerging role; distinguish a hat from a hire. Staff Agent Operations only when its work exists.</p></div>
    <div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-06-role-map-and-staffing-triggers</b><br>Pack F - People and operating model<br>fill order <b>3</b> &middot; type <b>inventory</b></div>

  <div class="ws-source">Source: <b>Team Structures for AI-Augmented Delivery</b>, <i>Domain Specialist</i> &middot; <code>handbook\ch06-team-structures.qmd</code> L156-198 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch06-team-structures.html#sec-domain-specialist">#sec-domain-specialist</a></div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">Use the completed WS-04-five-layer-supply-chain-canvas first. For each role, name its holder and mark dedicated, hat, or gap. Tick only Agent Operations triggers that are true today; decide whether to staff it, and write the condition that would change a “do not staff yet” verdict. Sign the extend-or-stand-up decision below.</div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Block F — the orchestrator charter <span class="ws-block-note">what the human decides across the execution</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:16%"><col style="width:41%"><col style="width:38%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th></th><th><span class="fno">33</span> Phase</th><th><span class="fno">34</span> What the orchestrator decides</th><th>Notes for this charter</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Before execution</span></div></td>
          <td class="prior">The plan: which concerns to address, which to defer, how to partition work across agents and waves, and what principles govern trade-offs.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L334-338</span></td><td class="locked">—</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">During execution</span></div></td>
          <td class="prior">Monitors progress and handles escalations; diagnoses whether a stall is a prompt, scope, or tooling problem; resolves conflicting output by the plan's principles or an explicit design decision.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L334-338</span></td><td class="locked">—</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">After execution</span></div></td>
          <td class="prior">Spot-checks critical changes, verifies test results, and decides whether output meets the acceptance criteria.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L334-338</span></td><td class="locked">—</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <table class="ws">
